metadata.title: Product Management - Sources
metadata.description: Curated product management references for discovery, strategy, roadmaps, metrics, AI tools, and AI governance.

discovery_and_user_research.name: GOV.UK Service Manual - User Research
discovery_and_user_research.relevance: Practical user research guidance with strong ethics and evidence discipline.

discovery_and_user_research.name: Nielsen Norman Group
discovery_and_user_research.relevance: Research-backed UX and user research articles; validate transferability to your context.

discovery_and_user_research.name: The Mom Test
discovery_and_user_research.relevance: Customer interview patterns to reduce bias and extract actionable insights.

discovery_and_user_research.name: Opportunity Solution Trees
discovery_and_user_research.relevance: Discovery structure for mapping outcomes to opportunities, solutions, and experiments.

discovery_and_user_research.name: Jobs-to-be-Done (JTBD)
discovery_and_user_research.relevance: Customer need framing for discovery and positioning; use with direct evidence rather than as a substitute for research.

strategy_positioning_and_planning.name: Amazon Leadership Principles - Customer Obsession / Working Backwards Context
strategy_positioning_and_planning.relevance: Stable Amazon source for the customer-backward mindset behind PR/FAQ and working-backwards workflows.

strategy_positioning_and_planning.name: April Dunford - Templates
strategy_positioning_and_planning.relevance: Positioning method and supporting templates; use with customer evidence and win/loss feedback.

strategy_positioning_and_planning.name: Good Strategy Bad Strategy (Richard Rumelt)
strategy_positioning_and_planning.relevance: Strategy kernel framing: diagnosis, guiding policy, coherent actions.

strategy_positioning_and_planning.name: ProdPad - Now Next Later Roadmaps
strategy_positioning_and_planning.relevance: Roadmapping format useful under uncertainty; keep outcomes, metrics, and guardrails explicit.

experimentation_and_metrics.name: Trustworthy Online Controlled Experiments (Kohavi, Tang, Xu)
experimentation_and_metrics.relevance: Controlled experimentation foundations and pitfalls for measurement, power, and interpretation.

experimentation_and_metrics.name: Google Analytics (Developers)
experimentation_and_metrics.relevance: Instrumentation and measurement reference for event definitions and success metrics.

experimentation_and_metrics.name: OpenTelemetry Documentation
experimentation_and_metrics.relevance: Vendor-neutral observability reference when product metrics depend on reliable telemetry.

experimentation_and_metrics.name: Google SRE Book
experimentation_and_metrics.relevance: SLIs, SLOs, and incident learning loops relevant to reliability requirements in PRDs.

experimentation_and_metrics.name: PostHog Product Analytics
experimentation_and_metrics.relevance: Product analytics and experimentation reference for technical teams.

experimentation_and_metrics.name: Amplitude Documentation
experimentation_and_metrics.relevance: Enterprise product analytics reference for event design, journeys, and experimentation workflows.

experimentation_and_metrics.name: Atlassian Team Playbook - OKRs
experimentation_and_metrics.relevance: Practical OKR facilitation guide with current, operational team-level patterns.

experimentation_and_metrics.name: CAC Payback Benchmarks 2026 (Aleph)
experimentation_and_metrics.relevance: 2026 CAC payback benchmarks (n=342 SaaS companies): top-quartile <=6 months, median ~16 months. Primary source for pmf-scorecard-b2b.yaml cac_payback_12mo thresholds.

experimentation_and_metrics.name: Net Revenue Retention Benchmarks 2026 (Digital Applied)
experimentation_and_metrics.relevance: 2026 NRR benchmarks by ACV band: enterprise ~118%, mid-market ~108%, SMB/blended ~99%. Primary source for pmf-scorecard-b2b.yaml nrr_net_revenue_retention notes.

experimentation_and_metrics.name: Retention Rates for Mobile Apps by Industry (Plotline)
experimentation_and_metrics.relevance: Mobile consumer app retention benchmarks by vertical: average D30 ~3-6%, top-quartile social D30 ~10-15%. Primary source for the mobile consumer retention table in pmf-measurement.md.

privacy_security_and_accessibility.name: GDPR (Regulation (EU) 2016/679)
privacy_security_and_accessibility.relevance: Primary privacy regulation reference; impacts data collection, retention, and consent in product work.

privacy_security_and_accessibility.name: WCAG 2.2 (W3C Recommendation)
privacy_security_and_accessibility.relevance: Accessibility baseline for product requirements and documentation artifacts.

privacy_security_and_accessibility.name: NIST SSDF (SP 800-218)
privacy_security_and_accessibility.relevance: Secure software development baseline for security requirements in PRDs.

ai_pm_tools_and_trends.name: Productboard - State of AI in Product Management
ai_pm_tools_and_trends.relevance: Current vendor report on AI adoption and workflow change in PM; useful as directional market context, not ground truth.

ai_pm_tools_and_trends.name: ChatPRD
ai_pm_tools_and_trends.relevance: Example AI-assisted PRD drafting tool; verify current fit, pricing, security, and output quality before recommending.

ai_pm_tools_and_trends.name: Atlassian - State of Product 2026
ai_pm_tools_and_trends.relevance: Current state-of-practice signal for how teams are incorporating AI into planning and delivery workflows.

ai_pm_tools_and_trends.name: AI Product Development Lifecycle (Parzen, Li, Nika — HBS Technical Note 624070, Feb 2024)
ai_pm_tools_and_trends.relevance: Primary source for the AI Product Development Lifecycle framework cited in references/operational-guide.md and references/ai-product-patterns.md. Verified 2026-07-11: authors are Michael Parzen, Jessie Li, and Marily Nika, not the prior (incorrect) attribution.

operator_content.name: Lenny Rachitsky - How to Develop Product Sense
operator_content.relevance: Practical breakdown of product sense as a learnable skill, with exercises for building empathy and creative judgment.

operator_content.name: Lenny Rachitsky - Mission, Vision, Strategy, Goals, Roadmap, Task
operator_content.relevance: End-to-end hierarchy from mission through task execution; useful for aligning strategy artifacts and roadmap structure.

operator_content.name: Lenny Rachitsky - Skills PMs Need to Build
operator_content.relevance: Synthesis of 20+ PM career ladders identifying core competencies and skill progression across levels.

operator_content.name: Lenny Rachitsky - Choosing Your North Star Metric
operator_content.relevance: Survey-backed guidance on selecting a North Star metric that aligns customer and business success, with examples from 40+ companies.

operator_content.name: Lenny Rachitsky - The Ultimate Guide to OKRs (Christina Wodtke)
operator_content.relevance: OKR crafting guide with common mistakes and practical patterns from the author of Radical Focus.

optional_ai_governance_and_automation.name: NIST AI RMF 1.0
optional_ai_governance_and_automation.relevance: AI risk management framing for AI-powered features and AI PRDs.

optional_ai_governance_and_automation.name: NIST AI RMF - Generative AI Profile
optional_ai_governance_and_automation.relevance: Generative AI-specific risk guidance for evaluation, misuse handling, and lifecycle controls.

optional_ai_governance_and_automation.name: ISO/IEC 42001 Overview
optional_ai_governance_and_automation.relevance: AI management system reference for governance expectations and control design.

optional_ai_governance_and_automation.name: EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689)
optional_ai_governance_and_automation.relevance: Primary regulatory text that affects transparency, risk, and lifecycle obligations for AI systems.

optional_ai_governance_and_automation.name: OpenAI Prompt Engineering Guide
optional_ai_governance_and_automation.relevance: Prompting reference for drafting and automating product documents; requires human review and evaluation.

optional_ai_governance_and_automation.name: Anthropic - Demystifying Evals for AI Agents
optional_ai_governance_and_automation.relevance: Operational guide for agent evaluation, regression testing, and task-based reliability measurement.
